pay_detail: $20.97 an hour for up to 135 hours over 9 weeks (the first week is unpaid)
name: WAGES Ten Week Internship Program
org: YMCA of Greater Seattle Social Impact Center
what_you_do: Explore a career path and get paid to learn job and life skills. The program is run with Thompson Hotels and Machinists INC and funded by the City of Seattle.
who_can_apply: Ages 17 to 24. Other eligibility rules are not listed on the page.
deadline_text: No dates posted. The page appears out of date (it mentions a 2025 event), so ask about the next cohort.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Today button on the page, which links to a YMCA job posting. You can also contact Ann Beasley at abeasley@seattleymca.org.
notes: Only 17 and 18 year olds are teens here. Washington requires a signed parent and school authorization form for every worker under 18 (L&I page). Confirm the pay and start date before planning around it.
